frozen_resource_role: task_card.json, evaluation_contract.json and parameter_freeze.json are verbatim design-source records; their historical implementation status is not rewritten
inspection_time_interpretation: No direct crop-water mutation or harvest settlement. All normal physical evolution caused by the 600 simulated seconds, including day boundaries, is retained.
reference_inspection_point: Immediately after the unchanged N01 public controller first observes all 64 ridges MATURE, before its first harvest call. No hidden maturity date or future weather is read.
feasibility_validator: BasicH01Scenario.validate: accepted v1.1 terminal validation plus audit_h01_ledger
state_basis: N01 v1.1 candidate_spec and complete parent initialization; only a candidate-specific tractor component is added
event_graph_policy: briefing_only; no validated H01 static oracle
path_metric_scope: No H01 static reference graph or oracle outcome is claimed. Any native path/FOS diagnostics are auxiliary and never replace actual warehouse quantity.
fullseason_acceptance: Recorded separately in the immutable run evidence; source installation alone does not establish an accepted trajectory
local_checkpoint_scope: Device state can be serialized. Full farm cross-process restoration and L1/L2 derivation remain outside this pilot.
